author: Inside Edition
description: Sydney Towles inspired millions on social media by preparing to run a marathon while battling cancer. But she died in August. Austin Towles was in awe of her his sister. He is keeping Sydney's dream alive by running the New York City marathon in her place. In just three months, he trained relentlessly to get ready for the big race. He spoke with Inside Edition's Alison Hall.
title: Brother To Run Marathon In Sister's Place After She Dies Of Cancer

author: Inside Edition
description: If you needed a reminder that tomorrow is Halloween, all you had to do was turn on your TV this morning. Inside Edition went behind the scenes as the "TODAY" show celebrated 100 years of NBC, with Savannah Guthrie and Jenna Bush Hager playing Rachel and Phoebe from "Friends." Over at "Live with Kelly and Mark," the hosts dressed as Lady Gaga and Bad Bunny from this year's Super Bowl. And it turns out, Elizabeth Holmes is one of the hottest costumes this Halloween.
title: TV Personalities Dress Up For Halloween

author: Inside Edition
description: Shocking recent surveillance video footage showed young mom Bella Torres fighting back when a man showed up at her house and attacked her while she was home with her two children. Now comes a surprising twist to the story: cops say the attack wasn't random. Law enforcement believes the man was actually sent by Bella's fiancé. Inside Edition's Ann Mercogliano has more on this surprising development.
title: Did Young Mom's Fiancé Send Man To Attack Her?

author: Inside Edition
description: President Trump is facing backlash after verbally attacking Reuters White House Correspondent Jacob Bogage. First the chief executive told the journalist he was "sick," "looks like hell" and was out of shape. Then, the White House social media team joined in, trolling Bogage on its accounts. The episode began when Bogage asked Trump if he had canceled campaign events because he was"sick of traveling.”
title: Trump Trolls Reuters Reporter Over His Weight

author: Inside Edition
description: State Troopers in Ohio were conducting a field sobriety test when they were nearly hit by an impaired driver, authorities say. The State Highway Patrol says it happened in Toledo. A driver and two troopers were out of their vehicles when an out-of-control vehicle came barreling through. No injuries were reported. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Allegedly Impaired Driver Nearly Hits Troopers Conducting Field Sobriety Test: Cops

author: Inside Edition
description: A New York mom has gone viral on TikTok after she posted a video about the tiny gummy bear her child got at a recent trunk-or-treat event her where her children got a tiny, individually wrapped gummy bear. Was it a recession indicator? Danielle Martin tells Inside Edition Digital it's a way for candy companies to get more bang for their buck.
title: Mom Asks If Tiny Halloween Gummy Bear Is Recession Indicator

author: Inside Edition
description: Check out these holy rollers. A collection of Popemobiles is on display for the first time, showcasing the evolution of motorized vehicles used by popes and the technological advancements that accompanied them. The exhibition, "A Century of the Popemobile," is on display until Jan. 31 at the Vatican Museums in Rome.
title: A Century of Popemobiles Are on Display in Vatican City

author: Inside Edition
description: The family of the most recently identified victim of serial killer Ted Bundy says the news wasn't unexpected. Darin Goff is the cousin of Melissa Ann Smith, a Utah teenager who went missing in October 1974 and turned up dead more than a week later. Goff says his family always suspected Bundy. Goff was a child when his cousin disappeared, but he remembers the tragedy that struck his family. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Family of Melissa Smith 'Not Surprised' Ted Bundy Is Identified as Her Killer

author: Inside Edition
description: Katie Zacharia served as White House Press Secretary for only five days. She had some cringeworthy public appearances, including an awkward Fox News interview with Sean Hannity. Now, in a new interview, Zacharia says she was not prepared for the hostility during her Fox News interview, which left her perplexed.
title: Katie Zacharia Speaks Out About Fox News Interview
